subject: GitLab @ 91e491cfc56 (branch sloppy/notes); ee/ and jh/ absent from this checkout

layers.title: Request edge and satellite services
layers.description: The Go and external services that sit in front of or beside Rails: Workhorse, GitLab Shell, Gitaly, KAS, Pages, the AI Gateway and Duo Workflow Service, OpenBao. Each talks to Rails through the internal API.

layers.title: Rails entry points
layers.description: How requests reach the Rails domain: the REST API (Grape), the GraphQL API, the internal API the satellites call, the Rails web layer (controllers, HAML, ViewComponent, mailers) and the Vue frontend.

layers.title: Rails domain
layers.description: The product subsystems inside the monolith: tenancy, authorization, authentication, repositories, merge requests, work items, CI/CD, packages, security, import/export, integrations, search, analytics, Markdown rendering, uploads, feature flags.

layers.title: Background processing and shared runtime
layers.description: What every domain uses at run time: Sidekiq workers, the Event Store, Redis (caching, rate limits, leases), instance settings and operations, and observability.

layers.title: Data layer
layers.description: PostgreSQL decomposed into main/ci/sec databases, the database dictionary and gitlab_schemas that say which table lives where, and ClickHouse for analytics.

layers.title: Editions, topology and deployment
layers.description: How one codebase runs as many shapes: the EE/JH extension mechanism, Cells (many instances behind one router), Geo (replicated secondaries), and upgrade and compatibility rules.

layers.title: Engineering system
layers.description: How the project is built, tested, reviewed and documented: RSpec/Jest, end-to-end QA, the project's own CI and review bots, the docs site, the AI agent principles and translations.

components.title: GitLab Workhorse
components.one_line: Go reverse proxy in front of Puma: serves Git HTTP, uploads and downloads, artifacts, LFS, image resizing, dependency proxy, Duo Workflow websockets and Geo proxying, asking Rails to pre-authorize each one.
evidence: workhorse/internal/gitaly/gitaly.go:2 Gitaly client for Git operations
lib/gitlab/workhorse.rb:12 SEND_DATA_HEADER Gitlab-Workhorse-Send-Data (Rails side of the contract)

components.title: Gitaly (and Praefect), through the Gitaly client
components.one_line: Every Git read and write goes over gRPC to Gitaly; the Rails side is Gitlab::GitalyClient and Gitlab::Git, the server version is pinned in GITALY_SERVER_VERSION.
evidence: git grep Gitlab::GitalyClient: 26 files in lib/gitlab, 6 app/services, 5 app/models, 4 lib/api, 4 app/controllers

components.title: GitLab Shell and gitlab-sshd
components.one_line: Separate Go service that handles Git over SSH; it asks Rails /internal/allowed whether a push or pull may happen, then proxies to Gitaly.
evidence: GITLAB_SHELL_VERSION (code lives in gitlab-org/gitlab-shell, not here)

components.title: GitLab agent for Kubernetes (KAS) and workspaces
components.one_line: KAS is the server side of agentk; Rails authorizes agents, proxies Kubernetes API calls and reconciles remote development workspaces through it.
evidence: lib/gitlab/background_migration/remote_development/* (workspaces code is otherwise in the absent ee/)

components.title: GitLab Pages
components.one_line: Go daemon serving static sites; Rails stores deployments produced by a CI job and answers the Pages daemon's domain lookups over the internal API.

components.title: GitLab Duo: AI features, AI Gateway and Duo Agent Platform
components.one_line: AI features call the AI Gateway and the Duo Workflow Service through Cloud Connector tokens; Workhorse carries the Duo Workflow websocket. Almost all of the Rails code is EE and absent from this checkout.

components.title: Secrets Manager (OpenBao)
components.one_line: Native secrets for CI jobs, backed by an OpenBao server per instance; only instrumentation and settings are in FOSS, the feature is EE.
evidence: no app/ or lib/ secrets_management code: it is in ee/, absent here

components.title: REST API (Grape)
components.one_line: The public /api/v4 surface, Grape endpoints with entities and helpers; also the Runner API CI jobs are fetched through.

components.title: GraphQL API
components.one_line: GitlabSchema: types, mutations, resolvers and subscriptions (over ActionCable) behind /api/graphql; the main API of the Vue frontend.

components.title: Internal API
components.one_line: The /api/v4/internal endpoints that Shell, Workhorse, KAS, Pages, Gitaly and Mailroom call; not public, but a contract several services agree on.
evidence: lib/api/api.rb:473-482 mounts Internal::Base, Ci::JobRouter, Lfs, Pages, Kubernetes, ErrorTracking, MailRoom, Workhorse, Shellhorse

components.title: Vue frontend
components.one_line: The Vue 2/3 single-page islands, Apollo GraphQL client, Pinia/Vuex state, GitLab UI, built with Webpack/Vite; about 6,900 files.

components.title: Rails web layer: controllers, views, components, mailers
components.one_line: Server-rendered pages: routes, controllers, HAML views, ViewComponent, helpers, the navigation sidebars and mailers; the frontend mounts on these pages.

components.title: GitLab Flavored Markdown (Banzai)
components.one_line: The filter pipeline that renders GFM and resolves references; its output is cached in *_html columns of every issuable, note and wiki.
evidence: git grep Banzai:: : lib/gitlab 9, app/models 7, app/controllers 5, app/services 3

components.title: Authorization: policies, roles and granular permissions
components.one_line: DeclarativePolicy abilities per model, predefined and custom roles, and the granular permission definitions in config/authz that API tokens are checked against.

components.title: Authentication, sessions, tokens and anti-abuse
components.one_line: Devise sign-in, OAuth/OmniAuth, personal/project/job tokens, sessions, identity verification, the IAM service client, and spam/CAPTCHA checks.

components.title: Tenancy: organizations, namespaces, groups and projects
components.one_line: The ownership hierarchy everything hangs from: organization > group namespaces > project namespaces; sharding keys and data isolation for Cells derive from it.

components.title: CI/CD
components.one_line: Pipeline configuration, creation chain, jobs, runners, artifacts, components and templates; the largest domain in lib/ and the main user of the ci database.

components.title: Merge requests, diffs and code review
components.one_line: Merge requests, mergeability checks, approvals and code owners, diffs (including Rapid Diffs) and merges executed by Gitaly.

components.title: Work items and issuables
components.one_line: Issues, tasks, epics and their widgets as one work item model; issuable concerns shared with merge requests.

components.title: Application security (Sec)
components.one_line: Security scanning: CI templates for analyzers, report parsing, vulnerabilities and SBOM ingestion. The ingestion and vulnerability code is EE and absent from this checkout; FOSS keeps the templates, report types and security configuration UI.

components.title: Import and export
components.one_line: Project/group export archives, direct transfer (bulk imports), the GitHub, Bitbucket and other importers, user contribution mapping and project templates.

components.title: Integrations and webhooks
components.one_line: Third-party integrations (Jira, Slack, Jenkins…) and project/group/system webhooks, all going out through the SSRF-guarded Gitlab::HTTP.

components.title: Search: basic, advanced (Elasticsearch/OpenSearch) and exact code (Zoekt)
components.one_line: SearchService dispatches to database search in FOSS and to Elasticsearch or Zoekt in EE; indexers are separate Go services.

components.title: Analytics instrumentation: internal events, metrics and Service Ping
components.one_line: Event and metric definitions (YAML), the internal events tracker, Snowplow, Redis HLL counters and the Service Ping payload.
evidence: git grep InternalEvents|track_internal_event: app/services 52, app/controllers 27, lib/gitlab 13, lib/api 12

components.title: Feature flags and experiments
components.one_line: Feature.enabled? over Flipper with YAML definitions for every flag, plus gitlab-experiment for A/B experiments.
evidence: git grep Feature.enabled?: lib/gitlab 117, app/services 55, app/controllers 50, app/models 49, lib/api 47, app/workers 39

components.title: Uploads and object storage
components.one_line: CarrierWave uploaders and the object storage layer; large files are accelerated by Workhorse and written straight to object storage.

components.title: Repositories and Git access
components.one_line: Project, wiki and snippet repositories: Git access checks and push rules, LFS, mirroring, storage moves and object pools, all over Gitaly.

components.title: Package and container registries
components.one_line: Package formats (npm, Maven, PyPI, Debian, Helm…), the dependency proxy and the container registry client; uploads go through Workhorse.

components.title: Sidekiq background jobs
components.one_line: About 640 workers with attributes (urgency, idempotency, data consistency), the queue routing config, middleware and sidekiq-cluster.

components.title: Event Store (domain events)
components.one_line: In-process publish/subscribe of domain events whose subscribers run as Sidekiq workers, used to decouple bounded contexts.
evidence: git grep Gitlab::EventStore: app/events 55, app/services 42, app/workers 25
app/events/{ci,merge_requests,work_items,packages,pages,repositories,organizations,projects,…}; git grep in app/services: merge_requests 6, projects 5, pages 4, organizations 4

components.title: Redis, caching and rate limiting
components.one_line: The several Redis instances (cache, shared state, queues, sessions, rate limiting…), Rails cache, reactive and ETag caching, exclusive leases and the application rate limiter.

components.title: Instance settings and operations
components.one_line: gitlab.yml and ApplicationSetting, cascading settings, application limits and secrets, maintenance mode, and backup/restore.

components.title: Observability: logging, metrics, SLIs and tracing
components.one_line: Labkit logging and Prometheus metrics, application SLIs, feature-category attribution, stage-group dashboards and distributed tracing.

components.title: PostgreSQL database layer
components.one_line: Connections to the decomposed databases with load balancing, migrations and batched background migrations, partitioning, loose foreign keys and query analyzers.
evidence: gems/gitlab-database-lock_retries: not in the root Gemfile or Gemfile.lock, yet lib/gitlab/database/* references LockRetries whose only definition is in that gem (load path unknown)

components.title: Database dictionary and gitlab_schemas
components.one_line: One YAML per table naming its gitlab_schema and sharding key, and the schema files that say which database each schema lives in and which may join; the agreement between decomposition, Cells and organizations.
evidence: schema counts: gitlab_main_org 856, gitlab_ci 113, gitlab_sec 113, gitlab_main 84, gitlab_main_cell_local 64

components.title: ClickHouse analytics store
components.one_line: A second, analytical datastore: its own migrations, finders and sync workers; Siphon replicates selected PostgreSQL tables into it.
evidence: git grep ClickHouse outside lib/click_house: lib/gitlab/database 33 files (migration/schema support), lib/gitlab/usage 2

components.title: Cells
components.one_line: Running GitLab.com as many cells behind an HTTP router: the Topology Service holds claims on globally unique attributes, organizations are the unit that is routed and moved.
evidence: app/models/concerns/cells/claimable.rb (included by 22 models: namespace, key, email, gpg_key…)

components.title: Geo
components.one_line: Read-only secondary sites replicating repositories and blobs from a primary, with Workhorse proxying writes. EE-only: no Geo Rails code is in this checkout.

components.title: EE and JH extension mechanism
components.one_line: FOSS classes end with prepend_mod so an ee/ (and jh/) module of the same name is injected when present; licensing gates EE features.
evidence: lib/gitlab_edition.rb:26-35 jh?/ee? and extension path prefixes
git grep prepend_mod: 1,655 call sites in 1,638 files of app/ and lib/
ee/ and jh/ are absent from this checkout (git ls-files ee jh is empty)

components.title: Test framework (RSpec, Jest, contract tests)
components.one_line: Unit, integration and feature specs, Jest frontend tests, contract tests, test-selection mapping and flaky-test handling.

components.title: End-to-end QA framework
components.one_line: Its own Ruby project: page objects, API-backed resources and scenarios run against a live GitLab.

components.title: The project's own CI pipelines, review bots and linters
components.one_line: The gitlab-org/gitlab pipeline definitions and tooling scripts, Danger, RuboCop cops, Keeps and the Housekeeper that open automated MRs.

components.title: Documentation site and docs process
components.one_line: The product docs under doc/, their style guide, topic types, linting (Vale, markdownlint) and the site that publishes them.

components.title: AI agent instructions and distilled development principles
components.one_line: AGENTS.md and .ai/: always-on rules plus principle files distilled from doc/development by gitlab-ai-principles-distiller, driven by .ai/principles/manifest.yml.

components.title: Internationalization
components.one_line: gettext strings for Ruby and JavaScript, extraction, pluralization and the Crowdin translation flow.
